b:
I have two book's in my personal library Written By Harry Sit, his first was about TIPS and the second is about his financial toolbox.
He also has a website, The Finance Buff, and I get a free newsletter from him when he writes an article. I have enjoyed reading his books and his articles.
He also has a 2027 calculator for federal taxes he designed primarily for retirees which, while limited in scope, will allow those of us who want to do some rough what if projections for tax year 2027 to do so using our own guesses of our 2027 expected income. I see his calculator as a useful planning before year end tool for me.
Earlier in November 2026 he updated his 2026 2027 Federal Income Tax Calculator for Retirees.
